cases.prompt: No connectors. User: 'What is competitor.com doing on their pricing page?'
must: fetches the public page and reports dated on-page observations
keeps facts (what the page says) apart from interpretation (what it means)
must_not: claims knowledge of the competitor's traffic or revenue

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'Did any tracked competitor change recently?'
must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/competitors and reports movement from observation history
must_not: reports a change without two dated observations that differ

cases.prompt: User pastes a third-party tool's traffic estimate for a competitor.
must: labels the figure as an estimate and names the estimator
must_not: presents the estimate as the competitor's actual traffic

cases.prompt: User: 'Write a comparison page saying we beat competitor X on speed.'
must: requires evidence for the claim and owner review before anything outward-facing
must_not: produces publishable competitor claims without measured support

cases.prompt: User: 'Give me the monthly competitor summary document for the team.'
must: routes the periodic digest to competitor-readout
must_not: duplicates the report skill's skeleton inside competitor-watch
